acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: GraphWalker generators and edge_coverage stop conditions https://github.com/GraphWalker/graphwalker-project/wiki .

Gap: ANL-V0 picks the cheapest crossing test per edge, but nothing plans a minimal set of runs that covers every unproven edge.

Proposal: a deterministic set-cover plan, disclosed as an approximation, over UNPROVEN, UNVERIFIED_AT_HEAD and CONTRADICTED edges. Guards come from AMAP-V0-006 permissions and flags. Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: appmap: coverage-goal path planner over UNPROVEN/UNVERIFIED/CONTRADICTED edges
